$comment: workflow.json — the 4-step assessment checklist. Source: paper p.12 and p.20.
intro: The following steps describe how a stakeholder assesses an explanation of a concrete AI model. Each scenario is self-contained, so models and explanations vary between scenarios.

steps.title: Context
steps.question: Understand the scenario before judging anything.
details: Domain: What is the application and purpose of the AI system?
Explainee: Who engages with the explanation?

steps.title: What the explainee sees
steps.question: Observe the explanation itself to judge (internal logical) coherence.
details: Output of the AI model: What does the AI model show as the output?
Explanation: What does the XAI method show as an explanation?

steps.title: Ground truth
steps.question: Consider the ground truth to judge validity.
details: Outcome: What would be the true prediction?
Premise: What are the causal assumptions for predictions?

steps.title: Actual model behavior
steps.question: Consider the actual model behavior to judge faithfulness.
details: How did the model actually come to this output?
